newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two Gulf of Mexico ports closed in strong winds.
newsitem.headline: Two Gulf of Mexico ports closed in strong winds.

text.p: Gulf of Mexico ports Tampico and Tuxpan in Tamaulipas state were closed Tuesday because of a cold front, the Communications and Transportations Ministry said.
State-owned oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos said its Pajaritos port in Veracruz has been closed to fishing boats only.
The port could be closed to crude oil shipping if the storm front worsens overnight, a company spokeswoman said.
Crude exports at Pajaritos, Dos Bocas and Cayo Arcos ports remained open late Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement the Tamaulipas ports were closed because of a polar air front carrying wind gusts of up to 30 knots from Missouri.
Altamira and Veracruz ports in Veracruz state were also shut to fishing and minor shipping, the ministry said.
